NE-senate.statusNote: Sen. Pete Ricketts (R) faces independent union leader Dan Osborn, who qualified for the November ballot by petition.

candidates.name: Pete Ricketts
candidates.background: U.S. Senator since 2023 (appointed, then elected in a 2024 special); Governor of Nebraska 2015–2023; former TD Ameritrade executive.

taxes.label: As governor: $408M property-tax relief, cut state spending growth 6.5%→0.6% (Ballotpedia)

repro.label: Moved to end Title X funds for abortion providers; signed pro-life legislation as governor (Ballotpedia)

candidates.name: Dan Osborn
candidates.background: Industrial mechanic and Navy veteran who led the 2021 Kellogg's strike in Omaha; ran a close independent race in 2024, running again in 2026. Petitioned onto the November ballot.

cost.label: Raise the federal minimum wage; cut taxes on overtime and small business; right-to-repair (Wikipedia)

immigration.label: Mixed: supports the border wall and security, and legalizing long-term non-criminal undocumented workers (Wikipedia)

taxes.label: Raise Social Security cap on high earners; criticizes 'tax cuts for the billionaires'; cut small-business taxes (Wikipedia)

repro.label: Personally pro-life, opposes a national ban; backs access within Roe limits, opposes late-term abortion (Wikipedia)
